description: NO-REGRESSION fixture for saga #811 (issue #816 item 4), the user-procedure twin of `turtle-rendering/arity-still-diagnosed/excess-literal-argument-primitive`. Asserts CORRECT behaviour that must survive the fix unchanged: `f` is declared arity-1 and called with two literals, and the excess token is rejected at PARSE as `ol-bad-token`, so nothing executes and `events` is empty. Compare `core-language/unresolvable-name/procedure-call-argument-execute`, where the same shape of call with an unresolvable NAME instead of an excess literal is discarded in silence.
